response.query: Which geomasking parameters (adaptive-donut radii tied to population density and k-anonymity targets) balance spatial privacy and analytic validity?
response.answer: Adaptive-donut radii tied to population density and k-anonymity targets balance spatial privacy and analytic validity by protecting individual privacy while maintaining data utility. Optimal parameters depend on local population density and desired k-anonymity level. Fine-tuning these parameters ensures both privacy and data accuracy.
